subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, native/docs i18n generation, saved browser preferences, and public docs?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable but changes shipped public locale identifiers, documented setup environment values, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the compatibility policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form inputs only as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publish metadata and navigation internals.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across onboarding docs, wizard i18n follow-up, and setup policy, which is where the compatibility decision needs to land.
